seeds.title: list ignores a checked-out unborn branch
seeds.detail: In a repo with no commit where HEAD points at sdlc/S-001, list --kind slice returns []. This follows from for-each-ref and the plan says an empty repo gives []. No action needed unless a caller expects the unborn branch.

seeds.title: cli-runner reaps nothing for git case-insensitive branch names
seeds.detail: On a case-insensitive filesystem git refuses two branches that differ only by case (feature/PROJ-1-S-001 and feature/proj-1-s-001). A fixture using {name:lower} needs a distinct name. Not a product defect.
